issues.location: code block under “如何用 AI 吃下微短剧这块 TAM”
issues.problem: The pseudocode comments remain in English. Because this is an illustrative code artifact, it is not a publish-blocker, but the comments are still reader-facing explanatory text in an otherwise Chinese article.
issues.suggestion: Consider translating only the `#` comments while preserving identifiers and string literals.

issues.location: section title “如何用 AI 吃下微短剧这块 TAM”
issues.problem: “吃下这块 TAM” is punchy but slightly startup-jargon-heavy in Chinese, and may feel less transparent than the surrounding prose.
issues.suggestion: A more natural option would be “如何用 AI 撬开微短剧的 TAM” or “如何用 AI 吃下微短剧市场”.

reviews.notes: The translation reads like natural Mandarin editorial prose rather than sentence-by-sentence English transfer. It preserves Ernie’s blunt, playful, technical-personal voice, translates quotations and attributions, keeps product/code terms intact, and the MDX structure appears sound. Minor polish notes do not affect publishability.

issues.location: 微短剧和 AI 段落 / “这套打法还能在哪里展开”
issues.problem: “where else might such a playbook unravel” 里的 “unravel” 更接近“铺开/复现/打开局面”，译成“展开”可以理解，但句子略抽象，少了一点原文在推演 playbook 可复制性的商业语气。
issues.suggestion: 可改为“这套打法还能在哪些地方复现”或“这套剧本还能在哪些行业跑通”。

issues.location: 观众为什么会迷上微短剧 / “捞金二婚妻”
issues.problem: “gold-digging second wife” 译成“捞金二婚妻”略生硬，像直译拼接，不如中文常用表达自然。
issues.suggestion: 可改为“拜金二婚妻”或“图钱的二婚妻”。

issues.location: 全球现象 / “高浓度狗血肥皂剧”
issues.problem: “soap on steroids” 的夸张感处理得基本成立，但“高浓度狗血肥皂剧”稍偏解释性，少了原文那种 blunt/playful 的压缩感。
issues.suggestion: 可考虑“打了鸡血的肥皂剧”或保留当前译法；不是发布阻断问题。

reviews.notes: 译文整体自然，标题和描述符合指定 house-style，正文没有明显英文句法硬搬、半翻译技术残留或术语误译。引文、引用归属和人名机构基本已面向中文读者处理，代码块保持原样合理；frontmatter 的 date/image 序列化差异与 translationStatus 均不构成质量问题。
